shellCommands.command:
grep -r "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.js 2>&1 | head
# Check Next.js version docs
grep -r "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/ --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 100

cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/http-access-fallback/http-access-fallback.js 2>&1 | head -n 80
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | grep -A5 authInterrupts
cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.react-server.d.ts
cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.js | head -n 100

git log --all --oneline | head -n 20
git status
cat next.config.ts
cat opencode.json

git diff HEAD
git show HEAD --stat
# check previous commit files
git show HEAD:package.json 2>&1 | head -n 100
ls -la .git/refs/

ls -la app/
cat app/layout.tsx
cat app/lib/auth.ts

npm run build 2>&1 | grep -A2 "Route"
# Check build output files
ls -la .next/server/app/admin/ 2>&1
cat .next/server/app/admin/page.js 2>&1 | head -n 200
cat .next/server/app/admin/forbidden.js 2>&1 | head -n 200

cat .next/server/app/forbidden.js 2>&1 | head -n 100
ls .next/server/app/ 2>&1
cat app/admin/page.tsx
# Check if we need dynamic

cat .next/server/app/admin.html 2>&1 | head -n 200
cat .next/server/app/admin.rsc 2>&1 | head -n 500
ls -la .next/server/app/admin/page/ 2>&1
cat .next/server/app/admin.meta 2>&1 | head -n 100

PORT=3003 npm run start 2>&1 &
sleep 3
curl -s -o /tmp/body.html -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3003/admin
echo
cat /tmp/body.html | head -n 200
curl -s -D - http://localhost:3003/admin -o /dev/null | head -n 20
# kill server
ps aux | grep next | head
kill %1 || pkill -f "next start" || true
sleep 1

pkill -f "next-server" 2>&1; sleep 1; ps aux | grep next | head
ls -la /workspace/app/admin/
cat /workspace/next.config.ts
cat /workspace/app/admin/page.tsx
cat /workspace/app/admin/forbidden.tsx
cat /workspace/app/forbidden.tsx
